newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end higher, near daily highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end higher, near daily highs.

text.p: Feb 4 - U.S. debt futures closed higher and near the highs of the session set late. Futures recovered from early losses on dealer and local buying, which in turn prompted technical buying above 112-05/32 in the March bond contract. Prices had fallen earlier when December new home sales fell to 783,000, which was stronger than the 745,000 unit rate expected. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
